Name: Easier Fishing(SMAPI and CP Uneeded)
Author: RielleTheWitch
Description:
I've lowered all of the arbitrary difficulty values for the fish, including the legendries. Generally speaking, depending on how i was feeling, they were lowered by a value between 5-20 units. The highest difficulty for the fish now is 90, with all legendries sharing this value. This is just a modified copy of the original .xnb file for stardew, all you need to do is replace this file in your game directory and your ready to go, explicit details on how to do this are in the README file that comes with the download. You will still have to actually pay attention while fishing, but hopefully it's less of a pain for those like me who struggled with the minigame.


--Ill be honest, completely forgot I made this, I only uploaded it intially on a whim just in case people found the same issues I had, I havent played stardew valley since the 1.6.8 update (unless you count testing the fix for this mod) so had no clue it wasnt working. Should be all fixed now, happy fishing!
